title: Reading the Buffer Frontier
statement: For all Boolean words $p$ and $b$, the buffer containing their concatenation, read at cell $|p|$, contains the first bit of $b$ if $b$ is nonempty, and is blank if $b$ is empty.
replaced:
For all Boolean words $p$ and $b$, the buffer tape holding the concatenation of $p$ and
$b$ (cells $0, \dots$ hold the word, every other cell is blank) reads, at cell $|p|$,
the first bit of $b$, or blank when $b$ is empty.
